title: Localization and common-field completion of fixed ring stages
statement: Fix a prime l, a closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X and Y, and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y, without absolute separatedness of X or Y. For every supplied ring-only assembly A [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data], there exist rational operations at every c,E, closed operations at every c, and their prescribed rational-left realizations. For R=A.complete built from exactly these outputs and the unchanged A, there are F:CoefficientConstructionFields R and M:CoefficientConstructionCommon R F [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data]. The localization shift structures at X and Y are independent of c, localization q is the identity on each raw represented integral left object, and the common-inclusion shift structures at X and Y are independent of c. No finite/integral operation or ring scalar is constructed by this statement. The representative-arrow normalization is included in M; the common-transition equation is to be deduced by the consumer from its identity-arrow specialization. No refinement is asserted.

source.place: Section 6, Constructions 6.2 and 6.6, after Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.24; original coefficient-stage construction step 5 and raw localization normalizations

proof.text: The prescribed integral compact support is coefficient-DVR-linear. Precompose it with finiteTorIntegralInclusion, transport linearity through A.integralLeft, and reflect the scalar equation on the underlying full-subcategory Hom. This proves linearity of the supplied integral F without changing it. Adjunction.right_adjoint_linear then proves linearity of its supplied G.

Apply exists_rational_stage_localization with these proved linearity hypotheses. Retain its rational operations, prescribed rational-left realizations, localization/scalar comparisons, raw action, and three localization normalizations.

Apply exists_common_stage_descent to this same rational family. Retain its closed operations, counit-normalized inclusion comparisons, identity normalization, two inclusion-shift independence properties and transition equation.

Construct R by A.complete on exactly those rational and closed operations. Use RationalStageAssembly.fields to construct F by assigning its five fields. Construct M with the supplied common comparisons and identity equations. For representativeAction, expand FΩ.map of a composite, left-compose by qi.hom and substitute the transition equation. Naturality of qj moves FΩ.map of the stage-inclusion arrow past qj; reassociate and cancel qi.hom followed by qi.inv. This proves the required formula for every stage arrow a, not just identity arrows.

Return the two operation families, rational-left realizations and the constructed F,M. Their five final properties are precisely the three localization properties and two common-inclusion shift properties already retained. All finite/integral operations and ring scalar data remain definitionally those of A.complete.

proof_origin.place: Constructions 6.2 and 6.6; integral linearity is proved by full-inclusion reflection and Mathlib linearity transport; raw rational localization and common-field descent are the two separate remaining steps. The full representative-arrow formula is proved from the transition equation by naturality and cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_field_stage_completion (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (A : RingStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f)) :
    ∃ (rational : ∀ (_c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
        Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y (.rational E))
      (closed : ∀ _c : Compactification f, Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y .closed)
      (rationalLeft : ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
        (rational c E).F ≅
          sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl)
            c E.carrier),
      let R := A.complete l Ω D hl rational closed rationalLeft
      ∃ F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R,
        ∃ M : CoefficientConstructionCommon.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F,
          (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
            (F.rationalizationComparison c E).shiftX =
              (F.rationalizationComparison d E).shiftX) ∧
          (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
            (F.rationalizationComparison c E).shiftY =
              (F.rationalizationComparison d E).shiftY) ∧
          (∀ (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l)
            (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral E)),
            HEq ((F.rationalizationComparison c E).q.hom.app K)
              (𝟙 ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E Y).obj
                ((A.operation c (.integral E)).F.obj K)))) ∧
          (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (i : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω),
            (M.commonComparison c i).shiftX = (M.commonComparison d i).shiftX) ∧
          (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (i : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω),
            (M.commonComparison c i).shiftY = (M.commonComparison d i).shiftY)
